catches: Use promo code NewPartner (shown as NEWPARTNER on the join page) when you open the account.
Open a checking account (online or in person at a member center).
Within the first 60 days, complete ONE of: $300 or more in combined direct deposits, OR 20 or more individual/combined debit or credit Mastercard transactions.
After the 60 days are up, $100 is deposited directly into the checking account.
Must be over 18 and the account must be in good standing at the time of payment.
